name: pf-fix-fishing-personal-loot
about: fix-fishing-personal-loot against the built packages keys, town instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). A hole's loot is the fisher's alone (2026-10-25, the user's item 2: gear from a catch dropped for every player). Solo half: a well spot on floor 1 or 3, one reel; the host logs `caught tier N (..): loot for them alone, K drop(s)` with K = the tier's pool count in loot_fishing.sval, and exactly K new item units lie near the player (SpawnCatchLoot rolls each pool once for the catcher instead of LootTable.SpawnLoot's once per player). The co-op half is the fishing README's manual step 7.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:fishing\] \w+ caught tier \d \(\d+ casts left\): loot for them alone, \d+ drop\(s\)

allow: Resource name hash conflict in package 'mods/(HWP-[a-z0-9]+|HammerwatchPlus-All)\.bin' for file
